meta.name: offensive-wifi-recon
meta.description: Wi-Fi reconnaissance methodology — adapter selection, monitor mode and packet injection setup, regulatory domain handling, multi-band airspace mapping, hidden SSID discovery, BSSID/ESSID/channel/PMF/encryption fingerprinting, client probe analysis, vendor OUI lookup, war-driving with Kismet/airodump-ng/Wigle, and structured airspace data capture for downstream attacks. Use at the start of any wireless engagement to build the target map before active attacks; covers 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz (Wi-Fi 6E) bands and adapter compatibility for each.

copy.tagline_en: Map wireless airspace, discover hidden SSIDs and client probes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你完成 Wi-Fi 侦察：选择适配器、开启监听模式、扫描 2.4/5/6 GHz 频段、发现隐藏 SSID、识别客户端和加密方式，并记录目标信息用于后续攻击。
howto.when: 在无线渗透测试开始时，需要构建目标网络地图时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描周围所有 Wi-Fi 频段，记录可见的 AP 和客户端。
say.note: Claude 会给出 airodump-ng 扫描命令。
Claude 会解释通过客户端探针或去认证获取。

say.text: 列出我当前适配器支持的频段和模式。
say.note: Claude 会给出 iw 和 lsusb 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through Wi-Fi reconnaissance: selecting an adapter, enabling monitor mode, scanning 2.4/5/6 GHz bands, discovering hidden SSIDs, identifying clients and encryption, and recording target data for subsequent attacks.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of a wireless engagement when you need to build a target map before active attacks.

say_en.text: Scan all Wi-Fi bands around me and log visible APs and clients.
say_en.note: Claude will provide airodump-ng scan commands.

say_en.text: How do I discover hidden SSIDs?
say_en.note: Claude explains via client probes or deauth.

say_en.text: List the bands and modes my current adapter supports.
say_en.note: Claude gives iw and lsusb commands.
